gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-zalando-sans: Commanding and wiry, Bellota Text keeps its stroke constant. Zalando Sans comes in below with curves that stay open-ended on every round letter, approachable and unfussy, so text can sit at a modest size.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-zalando-sans-expa: Letterforms bent from one length of tubing give Bellota Text a commanding, distinctive look. And Zalando Sans Expanded spreads out, wide gaps between letters and c tips that never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-zalando-sans-semi: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded is a modern sans whose curves open wide at every turn. And Bellota Text, drawn with a technical pen's line weight, is built for presence, while the body face is built for reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Fineliner-flat and commanding: Bellota Text sits above ZCOOL XiaoWei, a sans-serif whose strokes swell very faintly from stem to serif. Reading it feels steady yet softly modulated, line after line.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-n: Commanding and open, with no calligraphic shading: Bellota Text. Zen Kaku Gothic New, a sans with no hairlines and no swells, simply backs the heading up with open-mouthed curves.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-zen-maru-gothic: With no calligraphic shading to steer the eye, Bellota Text lands as commanding and distinct. Zen Maru Gothic then carries the reading like a single thread, never snagging on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-bellota-text-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans reads technical yet friendly, with wide channels into bowls. Bellota Text handles the commanding part with open shapes and not a hairline anywhere, leaving the sustained reading to the body face.
gen-gf-bellota-text-zilla-slab: Commanding curves with no stress in them, that's Bellota Text. Zilla Slab, a sturdy slab-serif with broad openings on every bowl-ended curve, makes the whole pairing feel properly engineered.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-clash-grotesk: Ruler-drawn lines of constant width give Bruno Ace its distinctive, expressive look. And Clash Grotesk, a sans with no modulation at all, would sit comfortably a few sizes smaller.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, with ascenders that look short because the lowercase is so tall. Alpino keeps its curve endings well apart under Bruno Ace, whose counters stay connected to the outside.
